--====================================================================

-- Full Script Replicated from 1000014089.mp4

-- 1. Initialize Rayfield UI Library Framework
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- 2. Create Window Interface
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "🎵 Ayush Music Hub v2 🎵",
   LoadingTitle = "Ayush Song Hub",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Script credit to ayush",
   Theme = "Default",
   DisableRayfieldPrompts = false,
   DisableBuildWarnings = false,
   ConfigurationHandler = {
      Enabled = true,
      FolderName = "AyushMusicHubConfig",
      FileName = "MainConfig"
   }
})

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🌈 OVERHEAD BILLBOARD TRACKER (From 0:23 in 1000014089.mp4)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local function createOverheadTag(char)
    local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
    if not head then return end
    
    if head:FindFirstChild("AyushMusicTag") then
        head.AyushMusicTag:Destroy()
    end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "AyushMusicTag"
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 50)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = head

    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.Text = "🎵 Ayush Music Hub 🎵"
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    textLabel.TextSize = 26
    textLabel.Parent = billboard

    task.spawn(function()
        while billboard and billboard.Parent do
            local hue = (tick() % 4) / 4
            textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

if player.Character then createOverheadTag(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(createOverheadTag)

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🎛️ TAB 1: PLAY CONTROLS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local PlayTab = Window:CreateTab("▶️ Play", 4483362458)
PlayTab:CreateSection("Ayush Song Hub | Instagram: @ayush_hub")

local CustomID = ""
PlayTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Enter Custom ID",
   PlaceholderText = "Paste song ID here...",
   RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
   Callback = function(Text)
      CustomID = Text
   end,
})

local function PlaySong(id)
    if workspace:FindFirstChild("GlobalMusic") then
        workspace.GlobalMusic.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        workspace.GlobalMusic:Play()
    end
end

PlayTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Play Manual ID",
   Callback = function()
      if tonumber(CustomID) then PlaySong(CustomID) end
   end,
})

PlayTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Stop Music",
   Callback = function()
      if workspace:FindFirstChild("GlobalMusic") then workspace.GlobalMusic:Stop() end
   end,
})

PlayTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Volume Control",
   Range = {0, 100},
   Increment = 1,
   Suffix = "%",
   CurrentValue = 50,
   Callback = function(Value)
      if workspace:FindFirstChild("GlobalMusic") then workspace.GlobalMusic.Volume = Value / 100 end
   end,
})

PlayTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Vehicle RGB",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(Value)
      -- RGB Vehicle Loop Placeholder
   end,
})

PlayTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Ayush Spammer",
   Callback = function()
      game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer("🎵 Ayush Music Hub dominates the server! 🎵", "All")
   end,
})

--------------------------------------------------------------------

    {"Monster", 1845016505},
    {"It Was a Good Day", 926493242},
